 Another Seddon Park SELL OUT | Limited tickets for Bay Oval
 Posted Sunday, November 8, 2026 in International News
 The green banks of Seddon Park will be packed once again with the Hamilton venue sold out for tomorrow’s third Hero VIDA ODI between the BLACKCAPS and India, Powered by Ai+ Nova Smartphone.
 Seddon Park hosted one of four sold-out matches during the T20I leg of India’s three-format tour, with more than 8,000 on deck to witness the BLACKCAPS seven-wicket victory.
 Tauranga’s Bay Oval will host the fourth and fifth ODIs on Friday and Sunday respectively, with approximately 10 percent of tickets remaining for both matches at the 9,500-capacity beachside venue.
 NZC’s Head of Marketing Tim Ellis was delighted to put up a fifth sold-out sign this summer.
 “The fans' response to this tour has been brilliant, and that’s made for some incredible atmospheres at the matches,” said Ellis. 
 “A cricket game involving India certainly hits different, and it’s been amazing to witness the colour, noise, and passion on display at venues.
 “There’s certainly a lot of excitement around with big stars like Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli in town in what feels like a bit of a farewell tour of New Zealand for two greats of the modern game.
 “With the Test matches also selling fast, our message to Kiwis remains the same, get your tickets organised now to avoid missing out on this landmark tour."
 Tickets are available to purchase at tickets.nzc.nz .
